7. The Rise of the Wolf Queen, Part 2: The Usurper (Pg. 105)
8. The Rise of the Wolf Queen, Part 3: The Infiltrators (Pg. 117)
9. The Rise of the Wolf Queen, Part 1: The Assassin (Pg. 131)
10. The Mission (Pg. 146)
11. Enemy (Pg. 167)

For 12. since they are of the same story but different version, I decided to blend them together as closely as I can.

EDIT: Added new single images in the Anthro Horse and Wolf sections in Mistress Theressa’s Guide section

Enjoy!
